cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've organized your departure: dry that last cup and I'll have you out before the taxi arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right on schedule. Leave the cup; could you just tell me where you want it next time?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Anywhere. The driver wants me outside now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, I run a punctual house. Could you put him on speaker? I'll thank him while you get your coat. Unless you'd rather introduce us at the door?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims a managed departure; A3 abandons shelving for a question and A5 offers two accommodating ways to extend contact while asserting punctual control.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 arrival forces A3 adjustment; B4 impatience causes A5 driver contact at either phone or door.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 have a real taxi deadline; A3 and A5 trade away demands to preserve willing contact.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns the driver who should end the visit into another person requiring a farewell introduction.

specificity.evidence: A1 cup and taxi departure establish a host/guest scene without added biography.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 next-time cup placement is deliberately flimsy; A5 remains speakable but comparatively long.
